title: Gentle Recovery Flow - Mobility & Breathwork

items.name: Cat-Cow
items.cues: Move slowly and deliberately. Inhale on cow (arching), exhale on cat (rounding). Focus on spinal mobility and breath coordination. Move at a controlled pace.

items.name: Bird Dog
items.cues: Extend opposite arm and leg slowly. Hold each rep for 1-2 seconds. Keep core stable and hips level. Breathe steadily throughout.

items.name: 90/90 Hip Switches
items.cues: Move gently between hip positions. Keep chest upright. Control the rotation through your hips. This prepares your joints for the main session.

items.name: Adductor Rockbacks
items.cues: Rock back slowly to feel a gentle inner-thigh stretch. Keep hips neutral and breathe into the stretch. Move with control, no bouncing. RPE should feel very easy and relaxing.

items.name: Biceps Wall Stretch
items.cues: Place arm against wall with palm facing forward. Gently rotate chest away. Hold comfortably without pain. Breathe deeply and relax into the stretch.

items.name: Calf Stretch
items.cues: Keep heel grounded, lean forward gently. Feel the stretch in your calf without forcing. Maintain steady breathing. Hold each side for the full duration.

items.name: Ankle Dorsiflexion Mobilization
items.cues: Pull toes toward shins gently and slowly. Move through full range without forcing. This improves ankle mobility and feels very comfortable. Breathe naturally.

items.name: Extended Child's Pose
items.cues: Rest forehead down, arms extended. Breathe deeply into your back body. Relax completely. Let tension melt away with each exhale.

items.name: Butterfly Pec Stretch (Supine Breathing)
items.cues: Lie on back with knees bent, soles of feet together. Let knees fall open gently. Breathe slowly and deeply. This opens the chest and allows full recovery.

items.name: Supine Full-Body Relaxation
items.cues: Lie flat with arms at sides, legs extended. Close eyes and breathe slowly. Mentally scan your body from head to toe, releasing any tension. Finish energized but calm.

rationale: After 999 days without training, a full recovery-focused session is essential to rebuild mind-body connection and prepare the body for consistent training over the next 91 days without risk of overuse injury.
RPE 4-5 intensity with mobility and recovery work allows the body to adapt gently while improving flexibility and range of motion—critical foundations for sustainable weight loss training ahead.
No equipment required bodyweight mobility exercises maximize accessibility and focus on movement quality, breathing patterns, and parasympathetic activation to support recovery and stress reduction.
